program.section_heading: Administration of Justice - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate knowledge of the breadth, scope and interconnectivity of the criminal justice system.
Demonstrate an understanding of the theories and research in the area of crime, criminality and criminal justice.
Demonstrate a basic knowledge of criminal law.
Demonstrate a knowledge of the implications of legal evidence in the processing of criminal cases.
Demonstrate a knowledge of the role of policing and the maintenance of favorable community relations.

notes: The catalog prints the A.S. Degree and Certificate of Achievement together under one heading with one set of requirements; this record reads that shared section for the A.S. Degree.
The Program Learning Outcomes are printed once for the program as a whole (degree and certificate); the A.S. Degree shares them.
The catalog prints codes with a hyphen (e.g., ADJ-1); these match the closed-list codes (e.g., ADJ 1).

Elective block reads 'Choose any elective courses in the discipline, or:' POLS-5 and SOC-20 — any Administration of Justice (ADJ) discipline course not otherwise required may also count toward the 9 elective units; these unnamed discipline electives are not listed as courses and open_elective_units is left null because they are restricted to the discipline, not open to any course.
The text says general education and other graduation requirements apply as described in the college catalog but does not name a GE pattern.
